pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pCleans dirty circuits into matching clean board variants.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Insert a Dirty circuit in an input slot.$p2. Supply its process cost and leave output room.$p3. Send the resulting board to analysis when a later use requires analysed state.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pDamaged circuits belong in Reassembly or Processing, not this cleaning-only path.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
